title: About me
subtitle: My story
description: From very early in my training, I was fascinated by the idea that a snippet of code could facilitate processes, connect people, and transform realities. This motivation has led me to specialize in full-stack development: I enjoy both building the user interface and designing the business logic that underpins it.

I am characterized by my ability to quickly adapt to new technological challenges (as seen in the various GitHub projects where I have explored both VanillaJS and modern frameworks), and by my strong commitment to continuous learning. I firmly believe that good development is not just about “making it work,” but about making it work well, be maintainable, and deliver real value. In the future, my goal is to continue collaborating in environments where I can contribute not only technical expertise, but also vision and a sense of responsibility in the delivery of digital products.
